name: io.github.tonyyang0504/matrix-mcp
description: Matrix (messaging): me, send, reply, list_inbound, get_thread, mark_read. Every tool maps to a docum

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_MATRIX_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Access token of the account (from a login flow or the client's settings), sent as 'Authorization: Bearer' — 'Access tokens may be provided via a request header, using the Authentication Bearer scheme: Authorization: Bearer TheTokenHere' (https://spec.matrix.org/latest/client-server-api/#using-access-tokens).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_MATRIX_HOMESERVER
environmentVariables.description: Host of the account's homeserver client API without scheme (e.g. matrix.org, or the m.homeserver base_url from /.well-known/matrix/client without https://); every call goes to https://<homeserver>/_matrix/client/... Env: PLATFORM_MCP_MATRIX_HOMESERVER.
